overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a robust and highly targeted academic social media presence across Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Mastodon, with a total following of 3,580. The audience is highly specialized and deeply engaged with updates on computational social science, disinformation research, and academic opportunities. Across all platforms, posts consistently achieve strong engagement rates, driven by announcements of research outputs, tool releases (like CooRnet), and professional opportunities.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, publications, and methodologies focusing on coordinated link sharing and information operations.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD student opportunities in computational social science.
Updates on software development, specifically the release and algorithmic improvements of the CooRnet tool.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's exceptionally high engagement rate by posting more frequently and initiating interactive academic discussions or Q&A threads.
Include visual assets, such as figures from published papers or screenshots of the CooRnet tool, to further boost engagement across all platforms.
Cross-promote major milestones like research grants across all three platforms with tailored messaging, maintaining professional depth on LinkedIn and academic informality on Bluesky.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most engaging platform by rate (avg. 6.14% ER). Audiences here are highly active in sharing (high repost-to-like ratio), making it the premier platform for amplifying new publications and call-for-applications.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon provides a highly dedicated niche audience (avg. 4.55% ER). It is highly receptive to specific technical announcements, such as CooRnet v2.0, demonstrating a strong base of developer and academic peers.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn yields the highest absolute engagement volume (averaging 90 total engagements per post). It is exceptionally effective for professional milestones, funding announcements, and recruitment drives due to its larger follower base.
